Quick internal update and risk call — I am classifying this as RED for the commit window unless we get SOC2 evidence by EOD 5/13. Summary and rationale:
- Why RED: SOC2 is a gating compliance artifact for procurement. Legal will not sign off on standard terms without evidence. We do not have a published SOC2 report in our public portal for this tenant.
- Immediate impact: procurement will deprioritize without evidence; risk of pushing to next cohort if we slip beyond 5/18.

Contingency (short-term actions) — 24–72 hour sprint:
A) Security team (Marissa) to produce an SOC2 attestation letter or a redacted report extract by 5/13 EOD. If full report unavailable, provide an executive attestation plus SOC2 readiness checklist.
B) Legal (Ben) to draft a short addendum offering temporary data isolation + indemnity language to bridge the gap — ready by 5/14.
C) Sales (Jordan) to prepare DocuSign with 30-day trial credit and route to procurement immediately when attestation lands.
D) CS/Engineering (Sean) to schedule an integration readiness call 5/12 and provide a technical runbook (SAML steps + sample config).

If A completes by 5/13, change classification to YELLOW and proceed with normal commit. If A/Miss -> remain RED and prepare to offer the addendum + extended trial credit to keep the deal live as a fallback.

Please confirm owners can commit to the timelines above. I will coordinate legal redline priorities if we get the attestation.

Ben Carter
